title: Pennsylvania Farm Conservation Easement: Becks protect 30-acre Bucks County farm; corridor aids at-risk wildlife
summary_full: A 30-acre farm in Bucks County, Pennsylvania, has recently been dedicated as a conservation easement by owners Leah and Doug Beck. This initiative safeguards the land from development, contributing to the preservation of local ecosystems alongside the adjacent Russell-Mandel Preserve. The Becks' passionate commitment to wildlife conservation plays a vital role in protecting essential habitats for diverse animal species in the region.
